where_it_appears: The confirmation question. Plain words, states cost and password. Now also states that installing Chrome switches on Google's apt source and what that means.
english_source:
Google Chrome is not installed yet.

It will be downloaded from Google and installed on this computer. This needs about 400 MB of space and an internet connection, and usually takes a few minutes.

You will be asked for your password.

Installing Chrome also switches on Google's software source, so that Chrome keeps receiving security updates. From then on this computer will contact Google regularly, even when you are not using Chrome. Until you say yes, it never does. If you remove Chrome later, the source is switched off again.

Install Google Chrome now?
our_translation:
Google Chrome aún no está instalado.

Se descargará de Google y se instalará en este ordenador. Necesita unos 400 MB de espacio y una conexión a internet, y suele tardar unos minutos.

Se le pedirá su contraseña.

Instalar Chrome también activa la fuente de software de Google, para que Chrome siga recibiendo actualizaciones de seguridad. A partir de entonces este ordenador contactará con Google con regularidad, incluso cuando no esté usando Chrome. Hasta que diga que sí, nunca lo hace. Si más adelante desinstala Chrome, la fuente se desactiva de nuevo.

¿Instalar Google Chrome ahora?

our_translation: Google Chrome está instalado y listo para usar.

Installation was cancelled, or the password was not accepted.

No se ha cambiado nada. Puede intentarlo de nuevo cuando quiera.

where_it_appears: Failure message. Leads with the likeliest cause, not an error code.
english_source:
Google Chrome could not be installed.

The most common reason is no internet connection. Please check your connection and try again.
our_translation:
No se pudo instalar Google Chrome.

La causa más común es la falta de conexión a internet. Compruebe su conexión e inténtelo de nuevo.

english_source: Welcome to Bashan OS
our_translation: Bienvenido a Bashan OS

english_source: Made by Bashan Tech LLC
our_translation: Creado por Bashan Tech LLC

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 1 body. Friendly, short.
english_source: Let us take two minutes to show you around.
our_translation: Vamos a dedicar dos minutos a enseñarte lo básico.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 2 heading.
english_source: What Bashan OS is
our_translation: Qué es Bashan OS

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 2 body. Plain words, no jargon.
english_source: Bashan OS is a complete desktop system. It is yours: there are no accounts to create, no advertising, and nothing is sent anywhere about what you do. It arrives ready for everyday work — writing, email, photographs, video and the web.
our_translation: Bashan OS es un sistema de escritorio completo. Es tuyo: no hay cuentas que crear, no hay publicidad y no se envía a ningún sitio información sobre lo que haces. Viene listo para el trabajo diario: escribir, correo, fotografías, vídeo y la web.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3 heading: the tour.
english_source: Finding your way around
our_translation: Cómo moverte por el sistema

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the dock, heading then body. Heading.
english_source: The dock
our_translation: La barra inferior

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the dock, heading then body. Body.
english_source: The bar along the bottom holds the programs you use most. Click an icon once to open it. A small glowing line appears underneath a program that is running.
our_translation: La barra de abajo contiene los programas que más usas. Haz clic una vez en un icono para abrirlo. Aparece una pequeña línea brillante debajo de un programa que está abierto.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Bashan launcher button. Heading.
english_source: The Bashan button
our_translation: El botón Bashan

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Bashan launcher button. Body.
english_source: The hand logo at the end of the dock opens the menu. Everything installed on the computer is in there, along with the buttons to shut down or restart.
our_translation: El logotipo de la mano al final de la barra abre el menú. Allí está todo lo instalado en el ordenador, junto con los botones para apagar o reiniciar.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the desktop widgets. Heading.
english_source: The panels on the desktop
our_translation: Los paneles del escritorio

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the desktop widgets. Body.
english_source: They show how the computer is doing, the weather, and your notes. Drag any of them somewhere else, or remove the ones you do not want.
our_translation: Muestran cómo va el ordenador, el tiempo y tus notas. Arrastra cualquiera a otro sitio o quita los que no quieras.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Heading.
english_source: The Trash
our_translation: La Papelera

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Body.
english_source: Files you delete wait in the Trash in the corner of the desktop. They are not really gone until you empty it, so a mistake can be undone.
our_translation: Los archivos que borras esperan en la Papelera, en la esquina del escritorio. No desaparecen de verdad hasta que la vacías, así que un error se puede deshacer.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the preinstalled apps. Heading.
english_source: Your programs
our_translation: Tus programas

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the preinstalled apps. Body.
english_source: LibreOffice for documents and spreadsheets, Thunderbird for email, Gwenview for photographs, VLC for video and music, Brave for the web.
our_translation: LibreOffice para documentos y hojas de cálculo, Thunderbird para el correo, Gwenview para las fotos, VLC para vídeo y música, Brave para la web.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 4 heading: settings.

our_translation: Hazlo tuyo

where_it_appears: Page 4: language setting heading.
english_source: Language
our_translation: Idioma

where_it_appears: Page 4: language setting body. Mentions RTL mirroring.
english_source: Bashan OS speaks thirteen languages. Change it in System Settings. For Arabic, Hebrew, Syriac, Sorani and Persian the whole desktop turns around to read right to left.
our_translation: Bashan OS habla trece idiomas. Cámbialo en la Configuración del sistema. Para el árabe, el hebreo, el siríaco, el sorani y el persa, todo el escritorio se invierte para leerse de derecha a izquierda.

where_it_appears: Page 4: theme setting heading.
english_source: Dark or light
our_translation: Oscuro o claro

where_it_appears: Page 4: theme setting body.
english_source: Bashan OS starts dark. Press the button to try the light look; press it again to come back.
our_translation: Bashan OS empieza en oscuro. Pulsa el botón para probar el aspecto claro; púlsalo otra vez para volver.

where_it_appears: Page 4: button that switches dark/light.
english_source: Switch the look
our_translation: Cambiar el aspecto

where_it_appears: Page 4: startup sound heading.
english_source: The startup sound
our_translation: El sonido de inicio

where_it_appears: Page 4: startup sound body.
english_source: A short piece of music plays while the computer starts. Turn it off here if you would rather have quiet.
our_translation: Una breve pieza de música suena mientras arranca el ordenador. Desactívala aquí si prefieres silencio.

where_it_appears: Page 4: checkbox label for the boot song.
english_source: Play the startup sound
our_translation: Reproducir el sonido de inicio

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 5 heading: more software.
english_source: Adding more programs
our_translation: Añadir más programas

where_it_appears: Page 5: Chrome heading.
english_source: Google Chrome
our_translation: Google Chrome

where_it_appears: Page 5: Chrome body. Explains why it is not preinstalled.
english_source: Chrome is not included in Bashan OS, because its licence does not let us pass it on to you. One click installs it straight from Google. You will need to be online.
our_translation: Chrome no viene incluido en Bashan OS porque su licencia no nos permite distribuirlo. Un clic lo instala directamente desde Google. Necesitarás conexión a internet.

where_it_appears: Page 5: software centre heading.
english_source: The software centre
our_translation: El centro de software

where_it_appears: Page 5: software centre body.
english_source: Thousands more free programs are a click away, including Krita for drawing, Audacity for sound and OBS Studio for recording your screen.
our_translation: Miles de programas gratuitos más están a un clic, entre ellos Krita para dibujar, Audacity para el sonido y OBS Studio para grabar la pantalla.

where_it_appears: Page 5: button that opens Discover.
english_source: Open the software centre

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6 heading: privacy and legal.
english_source: Privacy and legal
our_translation: Privacidad y aspectos legales

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6 body. Must be accurate about what connects out.
english_source: Bashan OS itself collects nothing about you. Some of the programs on it do reach the internet to do their job: your web browser, the software centre, and the system updates that keep the computer safe. The documents below list every one of them.
our_translation: Bashan OS en sí no recopila nada sobre ti. Algunos de los programas sí se conectan a internet para hacer su trabajo: tu navegador, el centro de software y las actualizaciones del sistema que mantienen seguro el ordenador. Los documentos de abajo los enumeran todos.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6: warning that the legal documents are drafts.
english_source: These documents are drafts awaiting review by a lawyer. They are not legal advice.
our_translation: Estos documentos son borradores pendientes de revisión por un abogado. No constituyen asesoramiento legal.

where_it_appears: Welcome app: unmute button.
english_source: Sound on
our_translation: Con sonido

our_translation: Puedes volver a abrir esta guía desde el menú Bashan cuando quieras.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 5 heading. Shown only to warn about disk encryption.
english_source: If you chose to encrypt this disk
our_translation: Si eligió cifrar este disco

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 5 body. The plain-words warning that a lost encryption password means lost data. Must stay blunt in every language.
english_source: Write the password down now and keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer. There is no reset, no recovery and no back door. If you forget it, everything on this disk is gone for good — not even we can get it back.
our_translation: Anote la contraseña ahora y guárdela en un lugar seguro, lejos de este ordenador. No hay restablecimiento, ni recuperación, ni puerta trasera. Si la olvida, todo lo que hay en este disco se pierde para siempre: ni siquiera nosotros podemos recuperarlo.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 heading: privacy tools.
english_source: Private browsing tools
our_translation: Herramientas de navegación privada

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 body. States that nothing is on by default.
english_source: Bashan OS includes two tools for when you do not want your internet connection watched. Neither is switched on, and neither does anything until you set it up. There is no account to make and nothing to pay.
our_translation: Bashan OS incluye dos herramientas para cuando no quiere que vigilen su conexión a internet. Ninguna está activada, y ninguna hace nada hasta que usted la configure. No hay que crear cuentas ni pagar nada.

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card heading.
english_source: A VPN
our_translation: Una VPN

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card body. Must say a VPN needs a server and warn about free services.
english_source: A VPN sends your internet traffic through another computer first. Bashan OS can connect to one, but it does not come with one: a VPN needs a server, either your own or a company's. Be careful with free VPN services — many of them keep records of what you do and sell them, which is the opposite of what you wanted.
our_translation: Una VPN envía su tráfico de internet a través de otro ordenador primero. Bashan OS puede conectarse a una, pero no trae ninguna: una VPN necesita un servidor, propio o de una empresa. Cuidado con los servicios de VPN gratuitos: muchos guardan registros de lo que hace y los venden, que es justo lo contrario de lo que buscaba.

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card heading.
english_source: Tor Browser
our_translation: Navegador Tor

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card body. Must say it downloads on first run, is slower, and some sites block it.
english_source: Tor hides which websites you visit by passing your traffic through several computers around the world. Opening it the first time downloads the browser from the Tor Project, so you need an internet connection. Two honest warnings: it is noticeably slower than normal browsing, and some websites and banks block it outright.
our_translation: Tor oculta qué sitios web visita pasando su tráfico por varios ordenadores repartidos por el mundo. Al abrirlo la primera vez se descarga el navegador desde el Proyecto Tor, así que necesita conexión a internet. Dos advertencias honestas: es bastante más lento que navegar normalmente, y algunos sitios y bancos lo bloquean directamente.

our_translation: Schreiben Sie das Passwort jetzt auf und bewahren Sie es sicher auf, nicht an diesem Computer. Es gibt kein Zurücksetzen, keine Wiederherstellung und keine Hintertür. Wenn Sie es vergessen, ist alles auf dieser Festplatte endgültig verloren — auch wir können es nicht zurückholen.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 body. States that nothing is on by default.
english_source: Bashan OS includes two tools for when you do not want your internet connection watched. Neither is switched on, and neither does anything until you set it up. There is no account to make and nothing to pay.
our_translation: Bashan OS enthält zwei Werkzeuge für den Fall, dass Ihre Internetverbindung nicht beobachtet werden soll. Keines ist eingeschaltet, und keines tut etwas, bevor Sie es einrichten. Es gibt kein Konto anzulegen und nichts zu bezahlen.

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card heading.
english_source: A VPN
our_translation: Ein VPN

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card body. Must say a VPN needs a server and warn about free services.
english_source: A VPN sends your internet traffic through another computer first. Bashan OS can connect to one, but it does not come with one: a VPN needs a server, either your own or a company's. Be careful with free VPN services — many of them keep records of what you do and sell them, which is the opposite of what you wanted.
our_translation: Ein VPN schickt Ihren Internetverkehr zuerst über einen anderen Rechner. Bashan OS kann sich mit einem verbinden, bringt aber keines mit: ein VPN braucht einen Server, entweder Ihren eigenen oder den einer Firma. Vorsicht bei kostenlosen VPN-Diensten — viele führen Protokoll über das, was Sie tun, und verkaufen es, also genau das Gegenteil dessen, was Sie wollten.

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card heading.
english_source: Tor Browser
our_translation: Tor Browser

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card body. Must say it downloads on first run, is slower, and some sites block it.
english_source: Tor hides which websites you visit by passing your traffic through several computers around the world. Opening it the first time downloads the browser from the Tor Project, so you need an internet connection. Two honest warnings: it is noticeably slower than normal browsing, and some websites and banks block it outright.
our_translation: Tor verbirgt, welche Webseiten Sie besuchen, indem es Ihren Verkehr über mehrere Rechner weltweit leitet. Beim ersten Öffnen wird der Browser vom Tor-Projekt heruntergeladen, Sie brauchen also eine Internetverbindung. Zwei ehrliche Warnungen: er ist spürbar langsamer als normales Surfen, und manche Webseiten und Banken sperren ihn ganz aus.

where_it_appears: The confirmation question. Plain words, states cost and password. Now also states that installing Chrome switches on Google's apt source and what that means.
english_source:
Google Chrome is not installed yet.

It will be downloaded from Google and installed on this computer. This needs about 400 MB of space and an internet connection, and usually takes a few minutes.

You will be asked for your password.

Installing Chrome also switches on Google's software source, so that Chrome keeps receiving security updates. From then on this computer will contact Google regularly, even when you are not using Chrome. Until you say yes, it never does. If you remove Chrome later, the source is switched off again.

Install Google Chrome now?
our_translation:
Google Chrome n'est pas encore installé.

Il sera téléchargé depuis Google et installé sur cet ordinateur. Cela nécessite environ 400 Mo d'espace et une connexion internet, et prend généralement quelques minutes.

Votre mot de passe vous sera demandé.

Installer Chrome active aussi la source de logiciels de Google, afin que Chrome continue de recevoir les mises à jour de sécurité. À partir de là, cet ordinateur contactera Google régulièrement, même lorsque vous n'utilisez pas Chrome. Tant que vous n'avez pas accepté, il ne le fait jamais. Si vous retirez Chrome plus tard, la source est de nouveau désactivée.

Installer Google Chrome maintenant ?

where_it_appears: Passive popup while the install runs.
english_source: Installing Google Chrome. This can take a few minutes — you can keep working.
our_translation: Installation de Google Chrome. Cela peut prendre quelques minutes ; vous pouvez continuer à travailler.

our_translation: Google Chrome est installé et prêt à l'emploi.

Rien n'a été modifié. Vous pouvez réessayer à tout moment.

where_it_appears: Failure message. Leads with the likeliest cause, not an error code.

our_translation:
Google Chrome n'a pas pu être installé.

La cause la plus fréquente est l'absence de connexion internet. Vérifiez votre connexion et réessayez.

where_it_appears: Tooltip under the installer icon.
english_source: Copy Bashan OS onto this computer
our_translation: Copiar o Bashan OS para este computador

where_it_appears: Title bar of every Chrome-installer dialog.
english_source: Install Google Chrome
our_translation: Instalar o Google Chrome

where_it_appears: Shown if Chrome turns out to be installed already.
english_source: Google Chrome is already installed.
our_translation: O Google Chrome já está instalado.

where_it_appears: The confirmation question. Plain words, states cost and password. Now also states that installing Chrome switches on Google's apt source and what that means.
english_source:
Google Chrome is not installed yet.

It will be downloaded from Google and installed on this computer. This needs about 400 MB of space and an internet connection, and usually takes a few minutes.

You will be asked for your password.

Installing Chrome also switches on Google's software source, so that Chrome keeps receiving security updates. From then on this computer will contact Google regularly, even when you are not using Chrome. Until you say yes, it never does. If you remove Chrome later, the source is switched off again.

Install Google Chrome now?
our_translation:
O Google Chrome ainda não está instalado.

Será descarregado da Google e instalado neste computador. Precisa de cerca de 400 MB de espaço e de uma ligação à internet, e demora normalmente alguns minutos.

Ser-lhe-á pedida a sua palavra-passe.

Instalar o Chrome também liga a fonte de software da Google, para que o Chrome continue a receber atualizações de segurança. A partir daí este computador contactará a Google regularmente, mesmo quando não estiver a usar o Chrome. Até dizer que sim, nunca o faz. Se remover o Chrome mais tarde, a fonte é desligada outra vez.

Instalar o Google Chrome agora?

where_it_appears: Passive popup while the install runs.
english_source: Installing Google Chrome. This can take a few minutes — you can keep working.
our_translation: A instalar o Google Chrome. Pode demorar alguns minutos — pode continuar a trabalhar.

where_it_appears: Success message.
english_source: Google Chrome is installed and ready to use.
our_translation: O Google Chrome está instalado e pronto a usar.

where_it_appears: Shown when the password prompt is dismissed.
english_source:
Installation was cancelled, or the password was not accepted.

Nothing has been changed. You can try again at any time.
our_translation:
A instalação foi cancelada ou a palavra-passe não foi aceite.

Nada foi alterado. Pode tentar novamente a qualquer momento.

where_it_appears: Failure message. Leads with the likeliest cause, not an error code.
english_source:
Google Chrome could not be installed.

The most common reason is no internet connection. Please check your connection and try again.
our_translation:
Não foi possível instalar o Google Chrome.

A causa mais comum é a falta de ligação à internet. Verifique a ligação e tente novamente.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 1 heading.
english_source: Welcome to Bashan OS
our_translation: Bem-vindo ao Bashan OS

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 1 body.
english_source: Your computer is being set up. This usually takes about ten minutes. You can leave it running.
our_translation: O seu computador está a ser configurado. Normalmente demora cerca de dez minutos. Pode deixá-lo a trabalhar.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 2 heading.
english_source: Everything you need, already installed
our_translation: Tudo o que precisa, já instalado

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 2 body.
english_source: Writer, spreadsheets and presentations. Email and calendar. A web browser. Photos, music and video. Nothing to download before you start.
our_translation: Processador de texto, folhas de cálculo e apresentações. Correio e calendário. Um navegador web. Fotografias, música e vídeo. Nada para descarregar antes de começar.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 3 heading.
english_source: Thirteen languages, written the right way round
our_translation: Treze idiomas, escritos no sentido certo

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 3 body.
english_source: Arabic, Hebrew, Syriac, Sorani and Persian read right to left, and Bashan OS lays itself out to match. You can change language at any time.
our_translation: O árabe, o hebraico, o siríaco, o sorani e o persa leem-se da direita para a esquerda, e o Bashan OS adapta-se. Pode mudar de idioma a qualquer momento.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 4 heading.
english_source: Private by default
our_translation: Privado por predefinição

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 4 body.
english_source: Bashan OS collects nothing and reports nothing. No usage data, no accounts, no tracking. Published by Bashan Tech LLC.
our_translation: O Bashan OS não recolhe nem comunica nada. Sem dados de utilização, sem contas, sem rastreio. Publicado pela Bashan Tech LLC.

where_it_appears: Shown on the installer's first screen, for the three languages Calamares has no translation for.
english_source: The installer itself is not available in Kurmanji, Sorani or Syriac. Choose English or Arabic to install — you can still set the computer to your own language afterwards.
our_translation: O instalador não está disponível em curmânji, sorani ou siríaco. Escolha inglês ou árabe para instalar — depois pode na mesma pôr o computador no seu idioma.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 1 heading.
english_source: Welcome to Bashan OS
our_translation: Bem-vindo ao Bashan OS

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 1 subtitle: the publisher.
english_source: Made by Bashan Tech LLC
our_translation: Criado por Bashan Tech LLC

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 1 body. Friendly, short.
english_source: Let us take two minutes to show you around.
our_translation: Vamos levar dois minutos para lhe mostrar o essencial.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 2 heading.
english_source: What Bashan OS is
our_translation: O que é o Bashan OS

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 2 body. Plain words, no jargon.
english_source: Bashan OS is a complete desktop system. It is yours: there are no accounts to create, no advertising, and nothing is sent anywhere about what you do. It arrives ready for everyday work — writing, email, photographs, video and the web.
our_translation: O Bashan OS é um sistema de ambiente de trabalho completo. É seu: não há contas para criar, não há publicidade e nada é enviado para lado nenhum sobre o que faz. Chega pronto para o trabalho do dia a dia — escrever, correio, fotografias, vídeo e a web.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3 heading: the tour.
english_source: Finding your way around
our_translation: Como se orientar

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the dock, heading then body. Heading.
english_source: The dock
our_translation: A barra inferior

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the dock, heading then body. Body.
english_source: The bar along the bottom holds the programs you use most. Click an icon once to open it. A small glowing line appears underneath a program that is running.
our_translation: A barra em baixo tem os programas que usa mais. Clique uma vez num ícone para o abrir. Aparece uma pequena linha luminosa por baixo de um programa que está aberto.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Bashan launcher button. Heading.
english_source: The Bashan button
our_translation: O botão Bashan

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Bashan launcher button. Body.
english_source: The hand logo at the end of the dock opens the menu. Everything installed on the computer is in there, along with the buttons to shut down or restart.
our_translation: O logótipo da mão no fim da barra abre o menu. Tudo o que está instalado no computador está lá, bem como os botões para desligar ou reiniciar.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the desktop widgets. Heading.
english_source: The panels on the desktop
our_translation: Os painéis no ambiente de trabalho

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the desktop widgets. Body.
english_source: They show how the computer is doing, the weather, and your notes. Drag any of them somewhere else, or remove the ones you do not want.
our_translation: Mostram como está o computador, o tempo e as suas notas. Arraste qualquer um para outro sítio, ou remova os que não quiser.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Heading.
english_source: The Trash
our_translation: O Lixo

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Body.
english_source: Files you delete wait in the Trash in the corner of the desktop. They are not really gone until you empty it, so a mistake can be undone.
our_translation: Os ficheiros que apaga ficam à espera no Lixo, ao canto do ambiente de trabalho. Só desaparecem mesmo quando o esvaziar, por isso um engano pode ser desfeito.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the preinstalled apps. Heading.
english_source: Your programs
our_translation: Os seus programas

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the preinstalled apps. Body.
english_source: LibreOffice for documents and spreadsheets, Thunderbird for email, Gwenview for photographs, VLC for video and music, Brave for the web.
our_translation: LibreOffice para documentos e folhas de cálculo, Thunderbird para o correio, Gwenview para fotografias, VLC para vídeo e música, Brave para a web.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 4 heading: settings.
english_source: Make it yours
our_translation: Torne-o seu

where_it_appears: Page 4: language setting heading.
english_source: Language
our_translation: Idioma

where_it_appears: Page 4: language setting body. Mentions RTL mirroring.
english_source: Bashan OS speaks thirteen languages. Change it in System Settings. For Arabic, Hebrew, Syriac, Sorani and Persian the whole desktop turns around to read right to left.
our_translation: O Bashan OS fala treze idiomas. Mude-o na Configuração do sistema. Para árabe, hebraico, siríaco, sorani e persa, todo o ambiente de trabalho se inverte para ler da direita para a esquerda.

where_it_appears: Page 4: theme setting heading.
english_source: Dark or light
our_translation: Escuro ou claro

where_it_appears: Page 4: theme setting body.
english_source: Bashan OS starts dark. Press the button to try the light look; press it again to come back.
our_translation: O Bashan OS começa escuro. Carregue no botão para experimentar o aspeto claro; carregue outra vez para voltar.

where_it_appears: Page 4: button that switches dark/light.
english_source: Switch the look
our_translation: Mudar o aspeto

where_it_appears: Page 4: startup sound heading.
english_source: The startup sound
our_translation: O som de arranque

where_it_appears: Page 4: startup sound body.
english_source: A short piece of music plays while the computer starts. Turn it off here if you would rather have quiet.
our_translation: Toca uma pequena peça de música enquanto o computador arranca. Desligue-a aqui se preferir silêncio.

where_it_appears: Page 4: checkbox label for the boot song.
english_source: Play the startup sound
our_translation: Reproduzir o som de arranque

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 5 heading: more software.
english_source: Adding more programs
our_translation: Adicionar mais programas

where_it_appears: Page 5: Chrome heading.
english_source: Google Chrome
our_translation: Google Chrome

where_it_appears: Page 5: Chrome body. Explains why it is not preinstalled.
english_source: Chrome is not included in Bashan OS, because its licence does not let us pass it on to you. One click installs it straight from Google. You will need to be online.
our_translation: O Chrome não vem incluído no Bashan OS porque a sua licença não nos permite distribuí-lo. Um clique instala-o diretamente a partir da Google. Vai precisar de ligação à internet.

where_it_appears: Page 5: software centre heading.
english_source: The software centre
our_translation: O centro de software

where_it_appears: Page 5: software centre body.
english_source: Thousands more free programs are a click away, including Krita for drawing, Audacity for sound and OBS Studio for recording your screen.
our_translation: Milhares de outros programas gratuitos estão a um clique, incluindo o Krita para desenhar, o Audacity para som e o OBS Studio para gravar o ecrã.

where_it_appears: Page 5: button that opens Discover.
english_source: Open the software centre
our_translation: Abrir o centro de software

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6 heading: privacy and legal.
english_source: Privacy and legal
our_translation: Privacidade e aspetos legais

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6 body. Must be accurate about what connects out.
english_source: Bashan OS itself collects nothing about you. Some of the programs on it do reach the internet to do their job: your web browser, the software centre, and the system updates that keep the computer safe. The documents below list every one of them.
our_translation: O próprio Bashan OS não recolhe nada sobre si. Alguns dos programas nele ligam-se à internet para fazer o seu trabalho: o seu navegador, o centro de software e as atualizações do sistema que mantêm o computador seguro. Os documentos abaixo enumeram-nos todos.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6: warning that the legal documents are drafts.
english_source: These documents are drafts awaiting review by a lawyer. They are not legal advice.
our_translation: Estes documentos são rascunhos à espera de revisão por um advogado. Não constituem aconselhamento jurídico.

where_it_appears: Welcome app: back button.
english_source: Back
our_translation: Voltar

where_it_appears: Welcome app: next button.
english_source: Next
our_translation: Seguinte

where_it_appears: Welcome app: finish button.
english_source: Finish
our_translation: Terminar

where_it_appears: Welcome app: the show-at-startup checkbox.
english_source: Show this when I start the computer
our_translation: Mostrar isto ao ligar o computador

where_it_appears: Welcome app: mute button for the welcome music.
english_source: Mute
our_translation: Silenciar

where_it_appears: Welcome app: unmute button.
english_source: Sound on
our_translation: Com som

where_it_appears: Welcome app: closing note on the last page.
english_source: You can open this guide again from the Bashan menu at any time.
our_translation: Pode voltar a abrir este guia a partir do menu Bashan quando quiser.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 5 heading. Shown only to warn about disk encryption.
english_source: If you chose to encrypt this disk
our_translation: Se escolheu cifrar este disco

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 5 body. The plain-words warning that a lost encryption password means lost data. Must stay blunt in every language.
english_source: Write the password down now and keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer. There is no reset, no recovery and no back door. If you forget it, everything on this disk is gone for good — not even we can get it back.
our_translation: Escreva a palavra-passe agora e guarde-a em lugar seguro, longe deste computador. Não há reposição, nem recuperação, nem porta das traseiras. Se a esquecer, tudo o que está neste disco perde-se para sempre — nem nós o conseguimos recuperar.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 heading: privacy tools.
english_source: Private browsing tools
our_translation: Ferramentas de navegação privada

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 body. States that nothing is on by default.
english_source: Bashan OS includes two tools for when you do not want your internet connection watched. Neither is switched on, and neither does anything until you set it up. There is no account to make and nothing to pay.
our_translation: O Bashan OS inclui duas ferramentas para quando não quer que a sua ligação à internet seja vigiada. Nenhuma está ligada, e nenhuma faz nada até que a configure. Não há conta para criar nem nada a pagar.

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card heading.
english_source: A VPN
our_translation: Uma VPN

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card body. Must say a VPN needs a server and warn about free services.
english_source: A VPN sends your internet traffic through another computer first. Bashan OS can connect to one, but it does not come with one: a VPN needs a server, either your own or a company's. Be careful with free VPN services — many of them keep records of what you do and sell them, which is the opposite of what you wanted.
our_translation: Uma VPN envia o seu tráfego de internet primeiro através de outro computador. O Bashan OS pode ligar-se a uma, mas não traz nenhuma: uma VPN precisa de um servidor, seu ou de uma empresa. Cuidado com os serviços de VPN gratuitos — muitos guardam registos do que faz e vendem-nos, que é o contrário do que pretendia.

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card heading.
english_source: Tor Browser
our_translation: Navegador Tor

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card body. Must say it downloads on first run, is slower, and some sites block it.
english_source: Tor hides which websites you visit by passing your traffic through several computers around the world. Opening it the first time downloads the browser from the Tor Project, so you need an internet connection. Two honest warnings: it is noticeably slower than normal browsing, and some websites and banks block it outright.
our_translation: O Tor esconde que sítios visita, passando o seu tráfego por vários computadores pelo mundo. Ao abri-lo pela primeira vez, o navegador é descarregado do Projeto Tor, por isso precisa de ligação à internet. Dois avisos honestos: é bastante mais lento do que navegar normalmente, e alguns sítios e bancos bloqueiam-no por completo.

where_it_appears: Tooltip for the Bashan app launcher in the dock.
english_source: The Bashan web app in its own window
our_translation: Веб-приложение Bashan в отдельном окне

our_translation: Ещё не установлен — нажмите, чтобы установить Google Chrome

It will be downloaded from Google and installed on this computer. This needs about 400 MB of space and an internet connection, and usually takes a few minutes.

From then on this computer will contact Google regularly, even when you are not using Chrome. Until you say yes, it never does. If you remove Chrome later, the source is switched off again.

Install Google Chrome now?
our_translation:
Google Chrome ещё не установлен.

Он будет загружен с серверов Google и установлен на этот компьютер. Потребуется около 400 МБ места и подключение к интернету; обычно это занимает несколько минут.

У вас будет запрошен пароль.

После этого компьютер будет регулярно связываться с Google, даже когда вы не пользуетесь Chrome. Пока вы не согласились, он этого не делает. Если позже удалить Chrome, источник снова отключается.

Установить Google Chrome сейчас?

where_it_appears: Passive popup while the install runs.
english_source: Installing Google Chrome. This can take a few minutes — you can keep working.
our_translation: Устанавливается Google Chrome. Это может занять несколько минут — можно продолжать работу.

Установка отменена или пароль не принят.

Ничего не изменено. Вы можете повторить попытку в любое время.

english_source:
Google Chrome could not be installed.

The most common reason is no internet connection. Please check your connection and try again.
our_translation:
Не удалось установить Google Chrome.

Чаще всего причина — отсутствие подключения к интернету. Проверьте подключение и повторите попытку.

our_translation: Панельки на рабочем столе

english_source: They show how the computer is doing, the weather, and your notes. Drag any of them somewhere else, or remove the ones you do not want.
our_translation: Они показывают состояние компьютера, погоду и ваши заметки. Перетащите любую в другое место или уберите ненужные.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Heading.
english_source: The Trash
our_translation: Корзина

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Body.
english_source: Files you delete wait in the Trash in the corner of the desktop. They are not really gone until you empty it, so a mistake can be undone.
our_translation: Удалённые файлы ждут в Корзине в углу рабочего стола. По-настоящему они исчезают, только когда вы её очистите, так что ошибку можно исправить.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the preinstalled apps. Heading.
english_source: Your programs
our_translation: Ваши программы

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the preinstalled apps. Body.
english_source: LibreOffice for documents and spreadsheets, Thunderbird for email, Gwenview for photographs, VLC for video and music, Brave for the web.
our_translation: LibreOffice для документов и таблиц, Thunderbird для почты, Gwenview для фотографий, VLC для видео и музыки, Brave для интернета.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 4 heading: settings.
english_source: Make it yours
our_translation: Настройте под себя

where_it_appears: Page 4: language setting heading.
english_source: Language
our_translation: Язык

where_it_appears: Page 4: language setting body. Mentions RTL mirroring.
english_source: Bashan OS speaks thirteen languages. Change it in System Settings. For Arabic, Hebrew, Syriac, Sorani and Persian the whole desktop turns around to read right to left.
our_translation: Bashan OS говорит на тринадцати языках. Измените его в Параметрах системы. Для арабского, иврита, сирийского, сорани и персидского весь рабочий стол разворачивается для чтения справа налево.

where_it_appears: Page 4: theme setting heading.
english_source: Dark or light
our_translation: Тёмная или светлая

where_it_appears: Page 4: theme setting body.
english_source: Bashan OS starts dark. Press the button to try the light look; press it again to come back.
our_translation: Bashan OS запускается в тёмном виде. Нажмите кнопку, чтобы попробовать светлый; нажмите ещё раз, чтобы вернуться.

where_it_appears: Page 4: button that switches dark/light.
english_source: Switch the look
our_translation: Сменить вид

where_it_appears: Page 4: startup sound heading.
english_source: The startup sound
our_translation: Звук при запуске

where_it_appears: Page 4: startup sound body.
english_source: A short piece of music plays while the computer starts. Turn it off here if you would rather have quiet.
our_translation: При запуске компьютера звучит короткая музыка. Выключите её здесь, если предпочитаете тишину.

where_it_appears: Page 4: checkbox label for the boot song.
english_source: Play the startup sound
our_translation: Воспроизводить звук при запуске

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 5 heading: more software.
english_source: Adding more programs
our_translation: Как добавить программы

where_it_appears: Page 5: Chrome heading.
english_source: Google Chrome
our_translation: Google Chrome

where_it_appears: Page 5: Chrome body. Explains why it is not preinstalled.
english_source: Chrome is not included in Bashan OS, because its licence does not let us pass it on to you. One click installs it straight from Google. You will need to be online.
our_translation: Chrome не входит в Bashan OS, потому что его лицензия не позволяет нам его передавать. Один щелчок установит его прямо от Google. Понадобится интернет.

where_it_appears: Page 5: software centre heading.
english_source: The software centre
our_translation: Центр программ

where_it_appears: Page 5: software centre body.
english_source: Thousands more free programs are a click away, including Krita for drawing, Audacity for sound and OBS Studio for recording your screen.
our_translation: Тысячи других бесплатных программ в одном щелчке, среди них Krita для рисования, Audacity для звука и OBS Studio для записи экрана.

where_it_appears: Page 5: button that opens Discover.
english_source: Open the software centre
our_translation: Открыть центр программ

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6 heading: privacy and legal.
english_source: Privacy and legal
our_translation: Приватность и правовая информация

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6 body. Must be accurate about what connects out.
english_source: Bashan OS itself collects nothing about you. Some of the programs on it do reach the internet to do their job: your web browser, the software centre, and the system updates that keep the computer safe. The documents below list every one of them.
our_translation: Сама Bashan OS ничего о вас не собирает. Некоторые программы в ней выходят в интернет, чтобы делать свою работу: ваш браузер, центр программ и обновления системы, которые держат компьютер в безопасности. Документы ниже перечисляют их все.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6: warning that the legal documents are drafts.
english_source: These documents are drafts awaiting review by a lawyer. They are not legal advice.
our_translation: Эти документы — черновики, ожидающие проверки юристом. Они не являются юридической консультацией.

where_it_appears: Welcome app: back button.
english_source: Back
our_translation: Назад

where_it_appears: Welcome app: next button.
english_source: Next
our_translation: Далее

where_it_appears: Welcome app: finish button.
english_source: Finish
our_translation: Готово

where_it_appears: Welcome app: the show-at-startup checkbox.
english_source: Show this when I start the computer
our_translation: Показывать это при запуске компьютера

where_it_appears: Welcome app: mute button for the welcome music.
english_source: Mute
our_translation: Выключить звук

where_it_appears: Welcome app: unmute button.
english_source: Sound on
our_translation: Включить звук

where_it_appears: Welcome app: closing note on the last page.
english_source: You can open this guide again from the Bashan menu at any time.
our_translation: Это руководство всегда можно снова открыть из меню Bashan.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 5 heading. Shown only to warn about disk encryption.
english_source: If you chose to encrypt this disk
our_translation: Если вы выбрали шифрование этого диска

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 5 body. The plain-words warning that a lost encryption password means lost data. Must stay blunt in every language.
english_source: Write the password down now and keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer. There is no reset, no recovery and no back door. If you forget it, everything on this disk is gone for good — not even we can get it back.
our_translation: Запишите пароль сейчас и храните его в надёжном месте, отдельно от компьютера. Нет ни сброса, ни восстановления, ни чёрного хода. Если вы его забудете, всё на этом диске пропадёт навсегда — даже мы не сможем это вернуть.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 heading: privacy tools.
english_source: Private browsing tools
our_translation: Инструменты приватного доступа

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 body. States that nothing is on by default.
english_source: Bashan OS includes two tools for when you do not want your internet connection watched. Neither is switched on, and neither does anything until you set it up. There is no account to make and nothing to pay.
our_translation: В Bashan OS есть два средства на случай, если вы не хотите, чтобы за вашим подключением следили. Ни одно не включено, и ни одно ничего не делает, пока вы его не настроите. Учётную запись создавать не нужно, платить не нужно.

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card heading.
english_source: A VPN
our_translation: VPN

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card body. Must say a VPN needs a server and warn about free services.
english_source: A VPN sends your internet traffic through another computer first. Bashan OS can connect to one, but it does not come with one: a VPN needs a server, either your own or a company's. Be careful with free VPN services — many of them keep records of what you do and sell them, which is the opposite of what you wanted.
our_translation: VPN пропускает ваш интернет-трафик сначала через другой компьютер. Bashan OS умеет подключаться к VPN, но своего не предоставляет: нужен сервер — ваш собственный или компании. Осторожнее с бесплатными VPN-сервисами: многие ведут записи о том, что вы делаете, и продают их, то есть делают ровно обратное тому, чего вы хотели.

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card heading.
english_source: Tor Browser
our_translation: Браузер Tor

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card body. Must say it downloads on first run, is slower, and some sites block it.
english_source: Tor hides which websites you visit by passing your traffic through several computers around the world. Opening it the first time downloads the browser from the Tor Project, so you need an internet connection. Two honest warnings: it is noticeably slower than normal browsing, and some websites and banks block it outright.
our_translation: Tor скрывает, какие сайты вы посещаете, пропуская трафик через несколько компьютеров по всему миру. При первом запуске браузер скачивается с сайта Tor Project, поэтому нужен интернет. Два честных предупреждения: он заметно медленнее обычного браузера, и некоторые сайты и банки его попросту блокируют.

where_it_appears: Tooltip for the Bashan app launcher in the dock.
english_source: The Bashan web app in its own window
our_translation: Η εφαρμογή ιστού Bashan σε δικό της παράθυρο

where_it_appears: Shown under the Chrome placeholder icon before Chrome is installed.
english_source: Not installed yet — click to install Google Chrome
our_translation: Δεν έχει εγκατασταθεί ακόμη — κάντε κλικ για εγκατάσταση του Google Chrome

english_source: Install Bashan OS
our_translation: Εγκατάσταση του Bashan OS

where_it_appears: Tooltip under the installer icon.
english_source: Copy Bashan OS onto this computer
our_translation: Αντιγραφή του Bashan OS σε αυτόν τον υπολογιστή

where_it_appears: Title bar of every Chrome-installer dialog.
english_source: Install Google Chrome
our_translation: Εγκατάσταση του Google Chrome

where_it_appears: Shown if Chrome turns out to be installed already.
english_source: Google Chrome is already installed.
our_translation: Το Google Chrome είναι ήδη εγκατεστημένο.

where_it_appears: The confirmation question. Plain words, states cost and password. Now also states that installing Chrome switches on Google's apt source and what that means.
english_source:
Google Chrome is not installed yet.

It will be downloaded from Google and installed on this computer. This needs about 400 MB of space and an internet connection, and usually takes a few minutes.

You will be asked for your password.

Installing Chrome also switches on Google's software source, so that Chrome keeps receiving security updates. From then on this computer will contact Google regularly, even when you are not using Chrome. Until you say yes, it never does. If you remove Chrome later, the source is switched off again.

Install Google Chrome now?
our_translation:
Το Google Chrome δεν έχει εγκατασταθεί ακόμη.

Θα ληφθεί από την Google και θα εγκατασταθεί σε αυτόν τον υπολογιστή. Χρειάζονται περίπου 400 MB χώρου και σύνδεση στο διαδίκτυο, και συνήθως διαρκεί μερικά λεπτά.

Θα σας ζητηθεί ο κωδικός σας.

Η εγκατάσταση του Chrome ενεργοποιεί επίσης την πηγή λογισμικού της Google, ώστε το Chrome να συνεχίσει να λαμβάνει ενημερώσεις ασφαλείας. Από εκεί και πέρα ο υπολογιστής θα επικοινωνεί τακτικά με την Google, ακόμη κι όταν δεν χρησιμοποιείτε το Chrome. Μέχρι να πείτε ναι, δεν το κάνει ποτέ. Αν αφαιρέσετε το Chrome αργότερα, η πηγή απενεργοποιείται ξανά.

Εγκατάσταση του Google Chrome τώρα;

where_it_appears: Passive popup while the install runs.
english_source: Installing Google Chrome. This can take a few minutes — you can keep working.
our_translation: Γίνεται εγκατάσταση του Google Chrome. Μπορεί να διαρκέσει μερικά λεπτά — μπορείτε να συνεχίσετε να εργάζεστε.

where_it_appears: Success message.
english_source: Google Chrome is installed and ready to use.
our_translation: Το Google Chrome εγκαταστάθηκε και είναι έτοιμο για χρήση.

where_it_appears: Shown when the password prompt is dismissed.
english_source:
Installation was cancelled, or the password was not accepted.

Nothing has been changed. You can try again at any time.
our_translation:
Η εγκατάσταση ακυρώθηκε ή ο κωδικός δεν έγινε δεκτός.

Δεν άλλαξε τίποτα. Μπορείτε να δοκιμάσετε ξανά οποτεδήποτε.

where_it_appears: Failure message. Leads with the likeliest cause, not an error code.
english_source:
Google Chrome could not be installed.

The most common reason is no internet connection. Please check your connection and try again.
our_translation:
Δεν ήταν δυνατή η εγκατάσταση του Google Chrome.

Η συνηθέστερη αιτία είναι η έλλειψη σύνδεσης στο διαδίκτυο. Ελέγξτε τη σύνδεσή σας και δοκιμάστε ξανά.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 1 heading.
english_source: Welcome to Bashan OS
our_translation: Καλώς ορίσατε στο Bashan OS

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 1 body.
english_source: Your computer is being set up. This usually takes about ten minutes. You can leave it running.
our_translation: Ο υπολογιστής σας ρυθμίζεται. Αυτό συνήθως διαρκεί περίπου δέκα λεπτά. Μπορείτε να τον αφήσετε να δουλεύει.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 2 heading.
english_source: Everything you need, already installed
our_translation: Όλα όσα χρειάζεστε, ήδη εγκατεστημένα

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 2 body.
english_source: Writer, spreadsheets and presentations. Email and calendar. A web browser. Photos, music and video. Nothing to download before you start.
our_translation: Κείμενα, υπολογιστικά φύλλα και παρουσιάσεις. Ηλεκτρονικό ταχυδρομείο και ημερολόγιο. Πρόγραμμα περιήγησης. Φωτογραφίες, μουσική και βίντεο. Τίποτα δεν χρειάζεται λήψη πριν ξεκινήσετε.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 3 heading.
english_source: Thirteen languages, written the right way round
our_translation: Δεκατρείς γλώσσες, γραμμένες προς τη σωστή κατεύθυνση

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 3 body.
english_source: Arabic, Hebrew, Syriac, Sorani and Persian read right to left, and Bashan OS lays itself out to match. You can change language at any time.
our_translation: Τα αραβικά, τα εβραϊκά, τα συριακά, τα σορανί και τα περσικά διαβάζονται από δεξιά προς τα αριστερά, και το Bashan OS προσαρμόζεται. Μπορείτε να αλλάξετε γλώσσα οποτεδήποτε.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 4 heading.
english_source: Private by default
our_translation: Ιδιωτικό εξ ορισμού

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 4 body.
english_source: Bashan OS collects nothing and reports nothing. No usage data, no accounts, no tracking. Published by Bashan Tech LLC.
our_translation: Το Bashan OS δεν συλλέγει και δεν αναφέρει τίποτα. Καθόλου δεδομένα χρήσης, λογαριασμοί ή παρακολούθηση. Εκδίδεται από την Bashan Tech LLC.

where_it_appears: Shown on the installer's first screen, for the three languages Calamares has no translation for.
english_source: The installer itself is not available in Kurmanji, Sorani or Syriac. Choose English or Arabic to install — you can still set the computer to your own language afterwards.
our_translation: Το ίδιο το πρόγραμμα εγκατάστασης δεν διατίθεται στα κουρμαντζί, σορανί ή συριακά. Επιλέξτε αγγλικά ή αραβικά για την εγκατάσταση — μπορείτε και πάλι να ρυθμίσετε τον υπολογιστή στη δική σας γλώσσα μετά.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 1 heading.
english_source: Welcome to Bashan OS
our_translation: Καλώς ορίσατε στο Bashan OS

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 1 subtitle: the publisher.
english_source: Made by Bashan Tech LLC
our_translation: Από την Bashan Tech LLC

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 1 body. Friendly, short.
english_source: Let us take two minutes to show you around.
our_translation: Ας αφιερώσουμε δύο λεπτά για μια σύντομη ξενάγηση.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 2 heading.
english_source: What Bashan OS is
our_translation: Τι είναι το Bashan OS

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 2 body. Plain words, no jargon.
english_source: Bashan OS is a complete desktop system. It is yours: there are no accounts to create, no advertising, and nothing is sent anywhere about what you do. It arrives ready for everyday work — writing, email, photographs, video and the web.
our_translation: Το Bashan OS είναι ένα πλήρες σύστημα επιφάνειας εργασίας. Είναι δικό σας: δεν υπάρχουν λογαριασμοί να δημιουργήσετε, δεν υπάρχουν διαφημίσεις και δεν στέλνεται πουθενά τίποτα για το τι κάνετε. Έρχεται έτοιμο για την καθημερινή εργασία: γραφή, αλληλογραφία, φωτογραφίες, βίντεο και το διαδίκτυο.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3 heading: the tour.
english_source: Finding your way around
our_translation: Πώς να βρίσκετε τον δρόμο σας

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the dock, heading then body. Heading.
english_source: The dock
our_translation: Η μπάρα κάτω

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the dock, heading then body. Body.
english_source: The bar along the bottom holds the programs you use most. Click an icon once to open it. A small glowing line appears underneath a program that is running.
our_translation: Η μπάρα στο κάτω μέρος έχει τα προγράμματα που χρησιμοποιείτε περισσότερο. Κάντε ένα κλικ σε ένα εικονίδιο για να το ανοίξετε. Μια μικρή φωτεινή γραμμή εμφανίζεται κάτω από ένα πρόγραμμα που εκτελείται.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Bashan launcher button. Heading.
english_source: The Bashan button
our_translation: Το κουμπί Bashan

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Bashan launcher button. Body.
english_source: The hand logo at the end of the dock opens the menu. Everything installed on the computer is in there, along with the buttons to shut down or restart.
our_translation: Το λογότυπο με το χέρι στην άκρη της μπάρας ανοίγει το μενού. Εκεί βρίσκονται όλα όσα είναι εγκατεστημένα στον υπολογιστή, μαζί με τα κουμπιά για τερματισμό ή επανεκκίνηση.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the desktop widgets. Heading.
english_source: The panels on the desktop
our_translation: Τα πλαίσια στην επιφάνεια εργασίας

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the desktop widgets. Body.
english_source: They show how the computer is doing, the weather, and your notes. Drag any of them somewhere else, or remove the ones you do not want.
our_translation: Δείχνουν πώς πάει ο υπολογιστής, τον καιρό και τις σημειώσεις σας. Σύρετε όποιο θέλετε αλλού, ή αφαιρέστε όσα δεν θέλετε.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Heading.
english_source: The Trash
our_translation: Ο Κάδος

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Body.
english_source: Files you delete wait in the Trash in the corner of the desktop. They are not really gone until you empty it, so a mistake can be undone.
our_translation: Τα αρχεία που διαγράφετε περιμένουν στον Κάδο, στη γωνία της επιφάνειας εργασίας. Δεν χάνονται στ' αλήθεια μέχρι να τον αδειάσετε, οπότε ένα λάθος διορθώνεται.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the preinstalled apps. Heading.
english_source: Your programs
our_translation: Τα προγράμματά σας

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the preinstalled apps. Body.
english_source: LibreOffice for documents and spreadsheets, Thunderbird for email, Gwenview for photographs, VLC for video and music, Brave for the web.
our_translation: LibreOffice για έγγραφα και λογιστικά φύλλα, Thunderbird για αλληλογραφία, Gwenview για φωτογραφίες, VLC για βίντεο και μουσική, Brave για το διαδίκτυο.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 4 heading: settings.
english_source: Make it yours
our_translation: Κάντε το δικό σας

where_it_appears: Page 4: language setting heading.
english_source: Language
our_translation: Γλώσσα

where_it_appears: Page 4: language setting body. Mentions RTL mirroring.
english_source: Bashan OS speaks thirteen languages. Change it in System Settings. For Arabic, Hebrew, Syriac, Sorani and Persian the whole desktop turns around to read right to left.
our_translation: Το Bashan OS μιλάει δεκατρείς γλώσσες. Αλλάξτε τη στις Ρυθμίσεις συστήματος. Για τα αραβικά, τα εβραϊκά, τα συριακά, τα σορανί και τα περσικά όλη η επιφάνεια εργασίας αντιστρέφεται για να διαβάζεται από δεξιά προς τα αριστερά.

where_it_appears: Page 4: theme setting heading.
english_source: Dark or light
our_translation: Σκούρο ή ανοιχτό

where_it_appears: Page 4: theme setting body.
english_source: Bashan OS starts dark. Press the button to try the light look; press it again to come back.
our_translation: Το Bashan OS ξεκινά σκούρο. Πατήστε το κουμπί για να δοκιμάσετε την ανοιχτή εμφάνιση· πατήστε το ξανά για να επιστρέψετε.

where_it_appears: Page 4: button that switches dark/light.
english_source: Switch the look
our_translation: Αλλαγή εμφάνισης

where_it_appears: Page 4: startup sound heading.
english_source: The startup sound
our_translation: Ο ήχος εκκίνησης

where_it_appears: Page 4: startup sound body.
english_source: A short piece of music plays while the computer starts. Turn it off here if you would rather have quiet.
our_translation: Ένα σύντομο μουσικό κομμάτι παίζει καθώς ξεκινά ο υπολογιστής. Απενεργοποιήστε το εδώ αν προτιμάτε ησυχία.

where_it_appears: Page 4: checkbox label for the boot song.
english_source: Play the startup sound
our_translation: Αναπαραγωγή ήχου εκκίνησης

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 5 heading: more software.
english_source: Adding more programs
our_translation: Προσθήκη κι άλλων προγραμμάτων

where_it_appears: Page 5: Chrome heading.
english_source: Google Chrome
our_translation: Google Chrome

english_source: Chrome is not included in Bashan OS, because its licence does not let us pass it on to you. One click installs it straight from Google. You will need to be online.

english_source: Write the password down now and keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer. There is no reset, no recovery and no back door. If you forget it, everything on this disk is gone for good — not even we can get it back.
our_translation: Γράψτε τον κωδικό τώρα και φυλάξτε τον σε ασφαλές μέρος, μακριά από αυτόν τον υπολογιστή. Δεν υπάρχει επαναφορά, ούτε ανάκτηση, ούτε κερκόπορτα. Αν τον ξεχάσετε, ό,τι υπάρχει σε αυτόν τον δίσκο χάνεται οριστικά — ούτε εμείς μπορούμε να το επαναφέρουμε.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 heading: privacy tools.
english_source: Private browsing tools
our_translation: Εργαλεία ιδιωτικής περιήγησης

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 body. States that nothing is on by default.
english_source: Bashan OS includes two tools for when you do not want your internet connection watched. Neither is switched on, and neither does anything until you set it up. There is no account to make and nothing to pay.
our_translation: Το Bashan OS περιλαμβάνει δύο εργαλεία για όταν δεν θέλετε να παρακολουθείται η σύνδεσή σας. Κανένα δεν είναι ενεργοποιημένο και κανένα δεν κάνει τίποτα μέχρι να το ρυθμίσετε. Δεν χρειάζεται λογαριασμός ούτε πληρωμή.

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card heading.
english_source: A VPN
our_translation: Ένα VPN

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card body. Must say a VPN needs a server and warn about free services.
english_source: A VPN sends your internet traffic through another computer first. Bashan OS can connect to one, but it does not come with one: a VPN needs a server, either your own or a company's. Be careful with free VPN services — many of them keep records of what you do and sell them, which is the opposite of what you wanted.
our_translation: Ένα VPN στέλνει την κίνησή σας πρώτα μέσα από έναν άλλο υπολογιστή. Το Bashan OS μπορεί να συνδεθεί σε ένα, αλλά δεν συνοδεύεται από κανένα: ένα VPN χρειάζεται διακομιστή, δικό σας ή μιας εταιρείας. Προσοχή στις δωρεάν υπηρεσίες VPN — πολλές κρατούν αρχείο όσων κάνετε και το πουλούν, δηλαδή ακριβώς το αντίθετο από αυτό που θέλατε.

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card heading.
english_source: Tor Browser
our_translation: Περιηγητής Tor

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card body. Must say it downloads on first run, is slower, and some sites block it.
english_source: Tor hides which websites you visit by passing your traffic through several computers around the world. Opening it the first time downloads the browser from the Tor Project, so you need an internet connection. Two honest warnings: it is noticeably slower than normal browsing, and some websites and banks block it outright.
our_translation: Το Tor κρύβει ποιες ιστοσελίδες επισκέπτεστε, περνώντας την κίνησή σας από αρκετούς υπολογιστές σε όλο τον κόσμο. Την πρώτη φορά κατεβάζει τον περιηγητή από το Tor Project, οπότε χρειάζεστε σύνδεση. Δύο ειλικρινείς προειδοποιήσεις: είναι αισθητά πιο αργό και ορισμένες ιστοσελίδες και τράπεζες το μπλοκάρουν εντελώς.

where_it_appears: The confirmation question. Plain words, states cost and password. Now also states that installing Chrome switches on Google's apt source and what that means.
english_source:
Google Chrome is not installed yet.

It will be downloaded from Google and installed on this computer. This needs about 400 MB of space and an internet connection, and usually takes a few minutes.

You will be asked for your password.

Installing Chrome also switches on Google's software source, so that Chrome keeps receiving security updates. From then on this computer will contact Google regularly, even when you are not using Chrome. Until you say yes, it never does. If you remove Chrome later, the source is switched off again.

Install Google Chrome now?
our_translation:
‏Google Chrome غير مُثبَّت بعد.

سيُنزَّل من Google ويُثبَّت على هذا الحاسوب. يحتاج نحو 400 ميغابايت من المساحة واتصالاً بالإنترنت، ويستغرق عادةً بضع دقائق.

سيُطلب منك كلمة المرور.

تثبيت كروم يُفعِّل أيضًا مصدر برمجيات جوجل، كي يستمر كروم في تلقي التحديثات الأمنية. ومنذ ذلك الحين سيتصل هذا الحاسوب بجوجل بانتظام، حتى حين لا تستخدم كروم. وما لم توافق، فإنه لا يفعل ذلك أبدًا. وإذا أزلت كروم لاحقًا، يُعطَّل المصدر من جديد.

هل تريد تثبيت Google Chrome الآن؟

Install Google Chrome now?

our_translation: سیستم‌عامل بشان چیست

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 2 body. Plain words, no jargon.
english_source: Bashan OS is a complete desktop system. It is yours: there are no accounts to create, no advertising, and nothing is sent anywhere about what you do. It arrives ready for everyday work — writing, email, photographs, video and the web.
our_translation: سیستم‌عامل بشان یک سیستم رومیزی کامل است. مال شماست: نیازی به ساختن حساب کاربری نیست، تبلیغاتی وجود ندارد و هیچ چیزی دربارهٔ کارهای شما به جایی فرستاده نمی‌شود. آماده برای کار روزمره می‌رسد: نوشتن، ایمیل، عکس، ویدئو و وب.

our_translation: نشان دست در انتهای نوار، منو را باز می‌کند. هر چه روی رایانه نصب شده آنجاست، همراه با دکمه‌های خاموش کردن یا راه‌اندازی دوباره.

our_translation: وضعیت رایانه، آب‌وهوا و یادداشت‌های شما را نشان می‌دهند. هر کدام را به جای دیگری بکشید، یا آن‌هایی را که نمی‌خواهید بردارید.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Heading.

our_translation: سطل زباله

our_translation: پرونده‌هایی که پاک می‌کنید در سطل زباله گوشهٔ میز کار می‌مانند. تا وقتی آن را خالی نکنید واقعاً از بین نمی‌روند، پس اشتباه را می‌شود جبران کرد.

our_translation: کروم در سیستم‌عامل بشان گنجانده نشده، چون پروانه‌اش به ما اجازه نمی‌دهد آن را به شما بدهیم. یک کلیک آن را مستقیم از گوگل نصب می‌کند. به اینترنت نیاز دارید.

our_translation: مرکز نرم‌افزار

where_it_appears: Page 5: button that opens Discover.

our_translation: باز کردن مرکز نرم‌افزار

our_translation: حریم خصوصی و حقوقی

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6 body. Must be accurate about what connects out.
english_source: Bashan OS itself collects nothing about you. Some of the programs on it do reach the internet to do their job: your web browser, the software centre, and the system updates that keep the computer safe. The documents below list every one of them.
our_translation: خودِ سیستم‌عامل بشان هیچ چیزی دربارهٔ شما جمع نمی‌کند. برخی از برنامه‌های روی آن برای انجام کارشان به اینترنت وصل می‌شوند: مرورگر شما، مرکز نرم‌افزار، و به‌روزرسانی‌های سیستم که رایانه را ایمن نگه می‌دارند. سندهای زیر همهٔ آن‌ها را فهرست می‌کنند.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6: warning that the legal documents are drafts.
english_source: These documents are drafts awaiting review by a lawyer. They are not legal advice.
our_translation: این سندها پیش‌نویس‌هایی هستند که در انتظار بررسی وکیل‌اند. مشاورهٔ حقوقی نیستند.

our_translation: این را هنگام روشن کردن رایانه نشان بده

our_translation: هر وقت خواستید می‌توانید این راهنما را دوباره از منوی بشان باز کنید.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 5 heading. Shown only to warn about disk encryption.
english_source: If you chose to encrypt this disk
our_translation: اگر رمزگذاری این دیسک را انتخاب کردید

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 5 body. The plain-words warning that a lost encryption password means lost data. Must stay blunt in every language.
english_source: Write the password down now and keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer. There is no reset, no recovery and no back door. If you forget it, everything on this disk is gone for good — not even we can get it back.
our_translation: رمز را همین حالا بنویسید و جایی امن، دور از این رایانه، نگه دارید. نه بازنشانی هست، نه بازیابی، نه در پشتی. اگر فراموشش کنید، هر چه روی این دیسک است برای همیشه از دست می‌رود — حتی ما هم نمی‌توانیم برش گردانیم.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 heading: privacy tools.
english_source: Private browsing tools
our_translation: ابزارهای مرور خصوصی

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 body. States that nothing is on by default.
english_source: Bashan OS includes two tools for when you do not want your internet connection watched. Neither is switched on, and neither does anything until you set it up. There is no account to make and nothing to pay.
our_translation: سیستم‌عامل بشان دو ابزار دارد برای وقتی که نمی‌خواهید اتصال اینترنتتان زیر نظر باشد. هیچ‌کدام روشن نیستند و تا وقتی خودتان تنظیمشان نکنید کاری نمی‌کنند. نه حسابی باید بسازید و نه پولی بدهید.

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card heading.
english_source: A VPN
our_translation: وی‌پی‌ان

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card body. Must say a VPN needs a server and warn about free services.
english_source: A VPN sends your internet traffic through another computer first. Bashan OS can connect to one, but it does not come with one: a VPN needs a server, either your own or a company's. Be careful with free VPN services — many of them keep records of what you do and sell them, which is the opposite of what you wanted.
our_translation: وی‌پی‌ان ترافیک اینترنت شما را اول از رایانه‌ای دیگر عبور می‌دهد. سیستم‌عامل بشان می‌تواند به یکی وصل شود، اما خودش هیچ‌کدام را ندارد: وی‌پی‌ان به یک سرور نیاز دارد، چه مال خودتان چه مال یک شرکت. مراقب سرویس‌های رایگان وی‌پی‌ان باشید — بسیاری از آن‌ها سابقهٔ کارهای شما را نگه می‌دارند و می‌فروشند، یعنی درست برعکس آنچه می‌خواستید.

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card heading.
english_source: Tor Browser
our_translation: مرورگر تور

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card body. Must say it downloads on first run, is slower, and some sites block it.
english_source: Tor hides which websites you visit by passing your traffic through several computers around the world. Opening it the first time downloads the browser from the Tor Project, so you need an internet connection. Two honest warnings: it is noticeably slower than normal browsing, and some websites and banks block it outright.
our_translation: تور با عبور دادن ترافیک شما از چند رایانه در سراسر جهان پنهان می‌کند که چه سایت‌هایی را می‌بینید. بار اول که بازش کنید مرورگر از پروژهٔ تور دانلود می‌شود، پس به اینترنت نیاز دارید. دو هشدار صادقانه: محسوساً از مرور عادی کندتر است، و بعضی سایت‌ها و بانک‌ها آن را کامل مسدود می‌کنند.

our_translation: Google Chrome jixwe hatiye sazkirin.

where_it_appears: The confirmation question. Plain words, states cost and password. Now also states that installing Chrome switches on Google's apt source and what that means.
english_source:
Google Chrome is not installed yet.

It will be downloaded from Google and installed on this computer. This needs about 400 MB of space and an internet connection, and usually takes a few minutes.

You will be asked for your password.
