english_source: The installer itself is not available in Kurmanji, Sorani or Syriac. Choose English or Arabic to install — you can still set the computer to your own language afterwards.
our_translation: خودی بەرنامەی دامەزراندن بە کورمانجی، سۆرانی یان سریانی بەردەست نییە. بۆ دامەزراندن ئینگلیزی یان عەرەبی هەڵبژێرە — دواتر هێشتا دەتوانیت کۆمپیوتەرەکە بە زمانی خۆت ڕێک بخەیت.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 1 heading.
english_source: Welcome to Bashan OS
our_translation: بەخێربێیت بۆ سیستەمی بەشان

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 1 subtitle: the publisher.
english_source: Made by Bashan Tech LLC
our_translation: دروستکراوی کۆمپانیای بەشان تێک

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 1 body. Friendly, short.
english_source: Let us take two minutes to show you around.
our_translation: با دوو خولەک کات تەرخان بکەین بۆ ئەوەی ڕێنماییت بکەین.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 2 heading.
english_source: What Bashan OS is
our_translation: سیستەمی بەشان چییە

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 2 body. Plain words, no jargon.
english_source: Bashan OS is a complete desktop system. It is yours: there are no accounts to create, no advertising, and nothing is sent anywhere about what you do. It arrives ready for everyday work — writing, email, photographs, video and the web.
our_translation: سیستەمی بەشان سیستەمێکی تەواوی ڕوومێزە. هی تۆیە: هیچ هەژمارێک دروست ناکرێت، هیچ ڕیکلامێک نییە، و هیچ شتێک دەربارەی ئەوەی تۆ دەیکەیت بۆ هیچ شوێنێک نانێردرێت. ئامادە دێت بۆ کاری ڕۆژانە: نووسین، ئیمەیڵ، وێنە، ڤیدیۆ و وێب.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3 heading: the tour.
english_source: Finding your way around
our_translation: ڕێگەی خۆت بدۆزەرەوە

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the dock, heading then body. Heading.
english_source: The dock
our_translation: شریتی خوارەوە

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the dock, heading then body. Body.
english_source: The bar along the bottom holds the programs you use most. Click an icon once to open it. A small glowing line appears underneath a program that is running.
our_translation: شریتی خوارەوە ئەو بەرنامانەی تێدایە کە زۆرترین جار بەکاریان دەهێنیت. جارێک کلیک لە وێنۆچکەیەک بکە بۆ کردنەوەی. هێڵێکی بچووکی درەوشاوە لە ژێر ئەو بەرنامەیەی کە کاردەکات دەردەکەوێت.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Bashan launcher button. Heading.
english_source: The Bashan button
our_translation: دوگمەی بەشان

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Bashan launcher button. Body.
english_source: The hand logo at the end of the dock opens the menu. Everything installed on the computer is in there, along with the buttons to shut down or restart.
our_translation: لۆگۆی دەست لە کۆتایی شریتەکە لیستەکە دەکاتەوە. هەموو ئەوەی لەسەر کۆمپیوتەرەکە دامەزراوە لەوێیە، لەگەڵ دوگمەکانی کوژاندنەوە و دەستپێکردنەوە.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the desktop widgets. Heading.
english_source: The panels on the desktop
our_translation: پانێلەکانی سەر ڕوومێز

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the desktop widgets. Body.
english_source: They show how the computer is doing, the weather, and your notes. Drag any of them somewhere else, or remove the ones you do not want.
our_translation: دۆخی کۆمپیوتەر، کەشوهەوا و تێبینییەکانت پیشان دەدەن. هەر یەکێکیان بۆ شوێنێکی تر ڕابکێشە، یان ئەوانەی ناتەوێت لایانبە.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Heading.
english_source: The Trash
our_translation: تەنەکەی خۆڵ

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Body.
english_source: Files you delete wait in the Trash in the corner of the desktop. They are not really gone until you empty it, so a mistake can be undone.
our_translation: ئەو پەڕگانەی دەیانسڕیتەوە لە تەنەکەی خۆڵ لە گۆشەی ڕوومێزەکە چاوەڕێ دەکەن. بەڕاستی نافەوتێن تا بەتاڵی نەکەیتەوە، بۆیە هەڵەیەک دەکرێت بگەڕێنرێتەوە.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the preinstalled apps. Heading.
english_source: Your programs
our_translation: بەرنامەکانت

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the preinstalled apps. Body.
english_source: LibreOffice for documents and spreadsheets, Thunderbird for email, Gwenview for photographs, VLC for video and music, Brave for the web.
our_translation: لیبرەئۆفیس بۆ بەڵگەنامە و خشتەکان، ساندەربێرد بۆ ئیمەیڵ، گوێنڤیو بۆ وێنەکان، VLC بۆ ڤیدیۆ و مۆسیقا، برەیڤ بۆ وێب.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 4 heading: settings.
english_source: Make it yours
our_translation: بیکە بە هی خۆت

where_it_appears: Page 4: language setting heading.
english_source: Language
our_translation: زمان

where_it_appears: Page 4: language setting body. Mentions RTL mirroring.
english_source: Bashan OS speaks thirteen languages. Change it in System Settings. For Arabic, Hebrew, Syriac, Sorani and Persian the whole desktop turns around to read right to left.
our_translation: سیستەمی بەشان سێزدە زمان دەزانێت. لە ڕێکخستنەکانی سیستەم بیگۆڕە. بۆ عەرەبی، عیبری، سریانی، سۆرانی و فارسی هەموو ڕوومێزەکە دەگەڕێتەوە بۆ ئەوەی لە ڕاستەوە بۆ چەپ بخوێنرێتەوە.

where_it_appears: Page 4: theme setting heading.
english_source: Dark or light
our_translation: تاریک یان ڕووناک

where_it_appears: Page 4: theme setting body.
english_source: Bashan OS starts dark. Press the button to try the light look; press it again to come back.
our_translation: سیستەمی بەشان بە تاریکی دەست پێدەکات. دوگمەکە دابگرە بۆ تاقیکردنەوەی ڕووخساری ڕووناک؛ دووبارە دابگرە بۆ گەڕانەوە.

where_it_appears: Page 4: button that switches dark/light.
english_source: Switch the look
our_translation: ڕووخسار بگۆڕە

where_it_appears: Page 4: startup sound heading.
english_source: The startup sound
our_translation: دەنگی دەستپێکردن

where_it_appears: Page 4: startup sound body.
english_source: A short piece of music plays while the computer starts. Turn it off here if you would rather have quiet.
our_translation: پارچە مۆسیقایەکی کورت کاتێک کۆمپیوتەرەکە دەستپێدەکات لێدەدرێت. لێرە بیکوژێنەوە ئەگەر بێدەنگیت پێ باشترە.

where_it_appears: Page 4: checkbox label for the boot song.
english_source: Play the startup sound
our_translation: دەنگی دەستپێکردن لێبدە

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 5 heading: more software.
english_source: Adding more programs
our_translation: زیادکردنی بەرنامەی زیاتر

where_it_appears: Page 5: Chrome heading.
english_source: Google Chrome
our_translation: گووگڵ کرۆم

where_it_appears: Page 5: Chrome body. Explains why it is not preinstalled.
english_source: Chrome is not included in Bashan OS, because its licence does not let us pass it on to you. One click installs it straight from Google. You will need to be online.
our_translation: کرۆم لە سیستەمی بەشاندا نییە، چونکە مۆڵەتەکەی ڕێگەمان پێنادات بۆ تۆی بنێرین. بە کلیکێک ڕاستەوخۆ لە گووگڵەوە دادەمەزرێت. پێویستت بە ئینتەرنێت دەبێت.

where_it_appears: Page 5: software centre heading.
english_source: The software centre
our_translation: ناوەندی نەرمەکاڵا

where_it_appears: Page 5: software centre body.
english_source: Thousands more free programs are a click away, including Krita for drawing, Audacity for sound and OBS Studio for recording your screen.
our_translation: هەزاران بەرنامەی خۆڕایی تر بە کلیکێک دوورن، لەوانە کریتا بۆ وێنەکێشان، ئۆداسیتی بۆ دەنگ و OBS Studio بۆ تۆمارکردنی شاشە.

where_it_appears: Page 5: button that opens Discover.
english_source: Open the software centre
our_translation: ناوەندی نەرمەکاڵا بکەرەوە

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6 heading: privacy and legal.
english_source: Privacy and legal
our_translation: تایبەتمەندی و یاسایی

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6 body. Must be accurate about what connects out.
english_source: Bashan OS itself collects nothing about you. Some of the programs on it do reach the internet to do their job: your web browser, the software centre, and the system updates that keep the computer safe. The documents below list every one of them.
our_translation: خودی سیستەمی بەشان هیچ شتێک دەربارەی تۆ کۆناکاتەوە. هەندێک لە بەرنامەکانی سەری بۆ ئەنجامدانی کارەکەیان دەگەنە ئینتەرنێت: وێبگەڕەکەت، ناوەندی نەرمەکاڵا، و نوێکارییەکانی سیستەم کە کۆمپیوتەرەکە پارێزراو دەهێڵنەوە. بەڵگەنامەکانی خوارەوە هەموویان لیست دەکەن.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6: warning that the legal documents are drafts.
english_source: These documents are drafts awaiting review by a lawyer. They are not legal advice.
our_translation: ئەم بەڵگەنامانە ڕەشنووسن و چاوەڕێی پێداچوونەوەی پارێزەرێکن. ڕاوێژی یاسایی نین.

where_it_appears: Welcome app: back button.
english_source: Back
our_translation: گەڕانەوە

where_it_appears: Welcome app: next button.
english_source: Next
our_translation: دواتر

where_it_appears: Welcome app: finish button.
english_source: Finish
our_translation: تەواو

where_it_appears: Welcome app: the show-at-startup checkbox.
english_source: Show this when I start the computer
our_translation: ئەمە پیشان بدە کاتێک کۆمپیوتەر دەکەمەوە

where_it_appears: Welcome app: mute button for the welcome music.
english_source: Mute
our_translation: بێدەنگ

where_it_appears: Welcome app: unmute button.
english_source: Sound on
our_translation: بە دەنگ

where_it_appears: Welcome app: closing note on the last page.
english_source: You can open this guide again from the Bashan menu at any time.
our_translation: دەتوانیت هەر کاتێک ئەم ڕێنمایییە لە لیستی بەشانەوە بکەیتەوە.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 5 heading. Shown only to warn about disk encryption.
english_source: If you chose to encrypt this disk
our_translation: ئەگەر هەڵتبژاردووە ئەم دیسکە بشێوێنیت

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 5 body. The plain-words warning that a lost encryption password means lost data. Must stay blunt in every language.
english_source: Write the password down now and keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer. There is no reset, no recovery and no back door. If you forget it, everything on this disk is gone for good — not even we can get it back.
our_translation: ئێستا وشەی نهێنی بنووسە و لە شوێنێکی پارێزراو، دوور لەم کۆمپیوتەرە، هەڵیبگرە. نە ڕێکخستنەوە هەیە، نە گەڕاندنەوە، نە دەرگای پشتەوە. ئەگەر لەبیرت بچێت، هەرچی لەم دیسکەدایە بۆ هەمیشە لەدەست دەچێت — تەنانەت ئێمەش ناتوانین بیگەڕێنینەوە.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 heading: privacy tools.
english_source: Private browsing tools
our_translation: ئامرازەکانی گەڕانی تایبەت

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 body. States that nothing is on by default.
english_source: Bashan OS includes two tools for when you do not want your internet connection watched. Neither is switched on, and neither does anything until you set it up. There is no account to make and nothing to pay.
our_translation: سیستەمی بەشان دوو ئامرازی تێدایە بۆ کاتێک نەتەوێت پەیوەندی ئینتەرنێتەکەت چاودێری بکرێت. هیچیان کارا نەکراون، و هیچیان هیچ ناکەن تا خۆت ڕێکیان نەخەیت. نە هەژمارێک دروست دەکەیت نە پارەیەک دەدەیت.

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card heading.
english_source: A VPN
our_translation: ڤی‌پی‌ئێن

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card body. Must say a VPN needs a server and warn about free services.
english_source: A VPN sends your internet traffic through another computer first. Bashan OS can connect to one, but it does not come with one: a VPN needs a server, either your own or a company's. Be careful with free VPN services — many of them keep records of what you do and sell them, which is the opposite of what you wanted.
our_translation: ڤی‌پی‌ئێن سەرەتا هاتوچۆی ئینتەرنێتەکەت بە کۆمپیوتەرێکی تردا دەنێرێت. سیستەمی بەشان دەتوانێت بە یەکێکەوە ببەستێت، بەڵام بە هیچێکەوە نایەت: ڤی‌پی‌ئێن پێویستی بە ڕاژەکارێکە، یان هی خۆت یان هی کۆمپانیایەک. ئاگاداری خزمەتگوزارییە خۆڕاییەکانی ڤی‌پی‌ئێن بە — زۆرێکیان تۆماری ئەوەی دەیکەیت هەڵدەگرن و دەیفرۆشن، کە پێچەوانەی ئەوەیە کە دەتویست.

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card heading.
english_source: Tor Browser
our_translation: وێبگەڕی تۆر

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card body. Must say it downloads on first run, is slower, and some sites block it.
english_source: Tor hides which websites you visit by passing your traffic through several computers around the world. Opening it the first time downloads the browser from the Tor Project, so you need an internet connection. Two honest warnings: it is noticeably slower than normal browsing, and some websites and banks block it outright.
our_translation: تۆر بە ناردنی هاتوچۆکەت بە چەند کۆمپیوتەرێکدا لە سەرانسەری جیهان، دەشارێتەوە سەردانی چ ماڵپەڕێک دەکەیت. یەکەم جار کە دەیکەیتەوە، وێبگەڕەکە لە پڕۆژەی تۆرەوە دادەبەزێنرێت، بۆیە پێویستت بە ئینتەرنێتە. دوو ئاگاداری ڕاستگۆیانە: بە ڕوونی لە گەڕانی ئاسایی خاوترە، و هەندێک ماڵپەڕ و بانق بە تەواوی ڕێگەی لێدەگرن.

where_it_appears: Tooltip for the Bashan app launcher in the dock.
english_source: The Bashan web app in its own window
our_translation: ܦܪܘܓܪܡܐ ܕܒܫܢ ܒܟܘܬܐ ܕܝܠܢܝܬܐ

where_it_appears: Shown under the Chrome placeholder icon before Chrome is installed.
english_source: Not installed yet — click to install Google Chrome
our_translation: ܠܐ ܐܬܬܣܝܡ ܥܕܟܝܠ — ܢܩܘܫ ܠܡܣܡ Google Chrome

where_it_appears: Desktop icon on the live ISO that starts the installer.
english_source: Install Bashan OS
our_translation: ܣܝܡ ܒܫܢ ܐܘ ܐܣ

where_it_appears: Tooltip under the installer icon.
english_source: Copy Bashan OS onto this computer
our_translation: ܟܬܘܒ ܒܫܢ ܐܘ ܐܣ ܥܠ ܗܢܐ ܚܫܘܒܐ

where_it_appears: Title bar of every Chrome-installer dialog.
english_source: Install Google Chrome
our_translation: ܣܝܡ Google Chrome

where_it_appears: Shown if Chrome turns out to be installed already.
english_source: Google Chrome is already installed.
our_translation: Google Chrome ܐܝܬܘܗܝ ܣܝܡܐ ܡܢ ܟܕܘ.

where_it_appears: The confirmation question. Plain words, states cost and password. Now also states that installing Chrome switches on Google's apt source and what that means.
english_source:
Google Chrome is not installed yet.

It will be downloaded from Google and installed on this computer. This needs about 400 MB of space and an internet connection, and usually takes a few minutes.

You will be asked for your password.

Installing Chrome also switches on Google's software source, so that Chrome keeps receiving security updates. From then on this computer will contact Google regularly, even when you are not using Chrome. Until you say yes, it never does. If you remove Chrome later, the source is switched off again.

Install Google Chrome now?
our_translation:
Google Chrome ܠܐ ܐܬܬܣܝܡ ܥܕܟܝܠ.

ܢܬܢܚܬ ܡܢ Google ܘܢܬܬܣܝܡ ܥܠ ܗܢܐ ܚܫܘܒܐ. ܣܢܝܩ ܥܠ ܐܝܟ 400 MB ܕܐܬܪܐ ܘܥܠ ܩܘܛܪܐ ܕܐܢܛܪܢܛ.

ܢܬܒܥܐ ܡܢܟ ܡܠܬܐ ܕܥܠܠܐ.

ܣܝܡܬܐ ܕܟܪܘܡ ܦܬܚܐ ܐܦ ܡܒܘܥܐ ܕܪܟܝܟܐ ܕܓܘܓܠ, ܕܢܣܒ ܟܪܘܡ ܚܘܕܬܐ ܕܙܗܝܪܘܬܐ. ܡܢ ܗܝ ܫܥܬܐ ܗܢܐ ܡܚܫܒܬܐ ܢܩܦ ܠܓܘܓܠ ܐܡܝܢܐܝܬ, ܐܦ ܟܕ ܠܐ ܡܬܚܫܚ ܐܢܬ ܒܟܪܘܡ. ܥܕܡܐ ܕܐܡܪ ܐܢܬ ܐܝܢ, ܠܐ ܥܒܕ ܗܕܐ ܡܡܬܘܡ. ܐܢ ܒܬܪܟܢ ܬܥܒܪ ܟܪܘܡ, ܡܒܘܥܐ ܬܘܒ ܡܬܛܦܐ.

ܬܣܝܡ Google Chrome ܗܫܐ؟

where_it_appears: Passive popup while the install runs.
english_source: Installing Google Chrome. This can take a few minutes — you can keep working.
our_translation: Google Chrome ܡܬܬܣܝܡ ܗܫܐ. ܡܨܐ ܕܢܐܚܘܕ ܩܠܝܠ ܩܛܝܢܐ.

where_it_appears: Success message.
english_source: Google Chrome is installed and ready to use.
our_translation: Google Chrome ܐܬܬܣܝܡ ܘܡܛܝܒ ܠܚܫܚܬܐ.

where_it_appears: Shown when the password prompt is dismissed.
english_source:
Installation was cancelled, or the password was not accepted.

Nothing has been changed. You can try again at any time.
our_translation:
ܐܬܒܛܠ ܣܝܡܐ ܐܘ ܠܐ ܐܬܩܒܠܬ ܡܠܬܐ ܕܥܠܠܐ.

ܠܐ ܐܫܬܚܠܦ ܡܕܡ.

where_it_appears: Failure message. Leads with the likeliest cause, not an error code.
english_source:
Google Chrome could not be installed.

The most common reason is no internet connection. Please check your connection and try again.
our_translation:
ܠܐ ܐܫܟܚ ܠܡܣܡ Google Chrome.

ܥܠܬܐ ܪܒܬܐ ܐܝܬܝܗ ܚܣܝܪܘܬ ܩܘܛܪܐ ܕܐܢܛܪܢܛ.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 1 heading.
english_source: Welcome to Bashan OS
our_translation: ܒܫܝܢܐ ܐܬܝܬܘܢ ܠܒܫܢ ܐܘ ܐܣ

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 1 body.
english_source: Your computer is being set up. This usually takes about ten minutes. You can leave it running.
our_translation: ܡܬܛܝܒ ܚܫܘܒܟ ܗܫܐ. ܢܐܚܘܕ ܐܝܟ ܥܣܪܐ ܩܛܝܢܐ.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 2 heading.
english_source: Everything you need, already installed
our_translation: ܟܠ ܡܕܡ ܕܣܢܝܩ ܐܢܬ ܥܠܘܗܝ ܣܝܡ ܡܢ ܟܕܘ

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 2 body.
english_source: Writer, spreadsheets and presentations. Email and calendar. A web browser. Photos, music and video. Nothing to download before you start.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 3 body.

our_translation: ܡܢܘ ܒܫܢ

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 2 body. Plain words, no jargon.
english_source: Bashan OS is a complete desktop system. It is yours: there are no accounts to create, no advertising, and nothing is sent anywhere about what you do. It arrives ready for everyday work — writing, email, photographs, video and the web.
our_translation: ܒܫܢ ܐܝܬܘܗܝ ܣܕܪܐ ܫܠܡܐ ܕܦܬܘܪܐ. ܕܝܠܟ ܗܘ: ܠܝܬ ܚܘܫܒܢܐ ܠܡܥܒܕ, ܠܝܬ ܡܘܕܥܢܘܬܐ, ܘܠܐ ܡܫܬܕܪ ܡܕܡ ܥܠ ܡܐ ܕܥܒܕ ܐܢܬ. ܐܬܐ ܡܛܝܒܐ ܠܥܒܕܐ ܕܟܠܝܘܡ: ܟܬܒܬܐ, ܐܓܪܬܐ, ܨܘܪܬܐ, ܚܙܘܢܐ ܘܐܝܢܬܪܢܬ.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3 heading: the tour.

english_source: The dock
our_translation: ܫܪܝܛܐ ܬܚܬܝܐ

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the dock, heading then body. Body.
english_source: The bar along the bottom holds the programs you use most. Click an icon once to open it. A small glowing line appears underneath a program that is running.
our_translation: ܫܪܝܛܐ ܕܠܬܚܬ ܐܝܬ ܒܗ ܒܪܢܡܐ ܕܣܓܝ ܡܬܚܫܚ ܐܢܬ ܒܗܘܢ. ܢܩܘܫ ܚܕܐ ܙܒܢܬܐ ܥܠ ܨܘܪܬܐ ܕܢܬܦܬܚ. ܣܪܛܐ ܙܥܘܪܐ ܢܗܝܪܐ ܡܬܚܙܐ ܬܚܘܬ ܒܪܢܡܐ ܕܦܠܚ.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Bashan launcher button. Heading.
english_source: The Bashan button
our_translation: ܙܪܐ ܕܒܫܢ

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Bashan launcher button. Body.
english_source: The hand logo at the end of the dock opens the menu. Everything installed on the computer is in there, along with the buttons to shut down or restart.
our_translation: ܐܬܐ ܕܐܝܕܐ ܒܣܘܦ ܫܪܝܛܐ ܦܬܚ ܠܣܕܪܐ. ܟܠ ܡܕܡ ܕܐܝܬ ܥܠ ܡܚܫܒܬܐ ܬܡܢ ܗܘ, ܥܡ ܙܪܐ ܕܛܦܝܬܐ ܘܕܫܘܪܝܐ ܚܕܬܐ.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the desktop widgets. Heading.
english_source: The panels on the desktop
our_translation: ܠܘܚܐ ܕܥܠ ܦܬܘܪܐ

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the desktop widgets. Body.
english_source: They show how the computer is doing, the weather, and your notes. Drag any of them somewhere else, or remove the ones you do not want.
our_translation: ܡܚܘܝܢ ܐܝܟܢܝܘܬܐ ܕܡܚܫܒܬܐ, ܐܐܪ ܘܪܫܡܬܟ. ܓܪܘܫ ܚܕ ܡܢܗܘܢ ܠܐܬܪܐ ܐܚܪܢܐ, ܐܘ ܐܥܒܪ ܐܝܠܝܢ ܕܠܐ ܨܒܐ ܐܢܬ.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Heading.
english_source: The Trash
our_translation: ܙܒܠܐ

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the Trash. Body.
english_source: Files you delete wait in the Trash in the corner of the desktop. They are not really gone until you empty it, so a mistake can be undone.
our_translation: ܐܕܫܐ ܕܡܚܝܬ ܠܗܘܢ ܡܟܬܪܝܢ ܒܙܒܠܐ ܒܙܘܝܬܐ ܕܦܬܘܪܐ. ܠܐ ܐܙܠܝܢ ܫܪܝܪܐܝܬ ܥܕܡܐ ܕܡܣܪܩ ܐܢܬ ܠܗ, ܡܛܠ ܗܕܐ ܡܨܐ ܐܢܬ ܠܡܗܦܟܘ ܛܥܝܘܬܐ.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the preinstalled apps. Heading.
english_source: Your programs
our_translation: ܒܪܢܡܐ ܕܝܠܟ

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 3: the preinstalled apps. Body.
english_source: LibreOffice for documents and spreadsheets, Thunderbird for email, Gwenview for photographs, VLC for video and music, Brave for the web.
our_translation: LibreOffice ܠܟܬܒܐ ܘܠܘܚܐ, Thunderbird ܠܐܓܪܬܐ, Gwenview ܠܨܘܪܬܐ, VLC ܠܚܙܘܢܐ ܘܙܡܪܐ, Brave ܠܐܝܢܬܪܢܬ.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 4 heading: settings.
english_source: Make it yours
our_translation: ܥܒܕܝܗܝ ܕܝܠܟ

where_it_appears: Page 4: language setting heading.
english_source: Language
our_translation: ܠܫܢܐ

where_it_appears: Page 4: language setting body. Mentions RTL mirroring.
english_source: Bashan OS speaks thirteen languages. Change it in System Settings. For Arabic, Hebrew, Syriac, Sorani and Persian the whole desktop turns around to read right to left.
our_translation: ܒܫܢ ܡܡܠܠ ܬܠܬܥܣܪ ܠܫܢܐ. ܫܚܠܦ ܠܗ ܒܛܘܟܣܐ ܕܣܕܪܐ. ܠܥܪܒܝܐ, ܥܒܪܝܐ, ܣܘܪܝܝܐ, ܣܘܪܢܝܐ ܘܦܪܣܝܐ ܟܠܗ ܦܬܘܪܐ ܡܬܗܦܟ ܕܢܬܩܪܐ ܡܢ ܝܡܝܢܐ ܠܣܡܠܐ.

where_it_appears: Page 4: theme setting heading.

where_it_appears: Page 4: theme setting body.
english_source: Bashan OS starts dark. Press the button to try the light look; press it again to come back.
our_translation: ܒܫܢ ܫܪܐ ܚܫܘܟܐ. ܕܚܘܩ ܙܪܐ ܕܬܢܣܐ ܚܙܘܐ ܢܗܝܪܐ; ܕܚܘܩ ܬܘܒ ܕܬܗܦܘܟ.

where_it_appears: Page 4: button that switches dark/light.
english_source: Switch the look
our_translation: ܫܚܠܦ ܚܙܘܐ

where_it_appears: Page 4: startup sound heading.
english_source: The startup sound
our_translation: ܩܠܐ ܕܫܘܪܝܐ

where_it_appears: Page 4: startup sound body.
english_source: A short piece of music plays while the computer starts. Turn it off here if you would rather have quiet.
our_translation: ܩܛܥܐ ܟܪܝܐ ܕܙܡܪܐ ܡܬܢܓܢ ܟܕ ܫܪܐ ܡܚܫܒܬܐ. ܛܦܝ ܠܗ ܗܪܟܐ ܐܢ ܨܒܐ ܐܢܬ ܫܠܝܐ.

english_source: Google Chrome

where_it_appears: Page 5: Chrome body. Explains why it is not preinstalled.
english_source: Chrome is not included in Bashan OS, because its licence does not let us pass it on to you. One click installs it straight from Google. You will need to be online.
our_translation: ܟܪܘܡ ܠܝܬ ܒܒܫܢ, ܡܛܠ ܕܫܘܠܛܢܗ ܠܐ ܫܒܩ ܠܢ ܕܢܬܠܝܘܗܝ ܠܟ. ܒܚܕܐ ܢܩܫܬܐ ܡܬܬܣܝܡ ܬܪܝܨܐܝܬ ܡܢ ܓܘܓܠ. ܣܢܝܩ ܐܢܬ ܥܠ ܐܝܢܬܪܢܬ.

where_it_appears: Page 5: software centre heading.
english_source: The software centre
our_translation: ܡܪܟܙܐ ܕܪܟܝܟܐ

where_it_appears: Page 5: software centre body.
english_source: Thousands more free programs are a click away, including Krita for drawing, Audacity for sound and OBS Studio for recording your screen.
our_translation: ܐܠܦܐ ܕܒܪܢܡܐ ܐܚܪܢܐ ܡܓܢܐ ܒܚܕܐ ܢܩܫܬܐ, ܐܝܟ Krita ܠܨܝܪܘܬܐ, Audacity ܠܩܠܐ ܘOBS Studio ܠܪܫܡ ܦܪܣܘܦܐ.

where_it_appears: Page 5: button that opens Discover.
english_source: Open the software centre
our_translation: ܦܬܚ ܡܪܟܙܐ ܕܪܟܝܟܐ

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6 heading: privacy and legal.
english_source: Privacy and legal
our_translation: ܟܣܝܘܬܐ ܘܕܝܢܐ

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6 body. Must be accurate about what connects out.
english_source: Bashan OS itself collects nothing about you. Some of the programs on it do reach the internet to do their job: your web browser, the software centre, and the system updates that keep the computer safe. The documents below list every one of them.
our_translation: ܒܫܢ ܗܘ ܠܐ ܟܢܫ ܡܕܡ ܥܠܝܟ. ܡܢ ܒܪܢܡܐ ܕܥܠܘܗܝ ܐܝܬ ܕܡܛܝܢ ܠܐܝܢܬܪܢܬ ܕܢܥܒܕܘܢ ܥܒܕܗܘܢ: ܡܥܒܪܢܐ ܕܝܠܟ, ܡܪܟܙܐ ܕܪܟܝܟܐ, ܘܚܘܕܬܐ ܕܣܕܪܐ ܕܢܛܪܝܢ ܡܚܫܒܬܐ. ܟܬܒܐ ܕܠܬܚܬ ܡܢܝܢ ܠܟܠܗܘܢ.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 6: warning that the legal documents are drafts.
english_source: These documents are drafts awaiting review by a lawyer. They are not legal advice.
our_translation: ܟܬܒܐ ܗܠܝܢ ܪܫܡܐ ܐܢܘܢ ܕܡܟܬܪܝܢ ܠܒܘܚܪܢܐ ܕܣܦܪ ܕܝܢܐ. ܠܐ ܐܢܘܢ ܡܠܟܐ ܕܕܝܢܐ.

where_it_appears: Welcome app: back button.
english_source: Back
our_translation: ܠܒܣܬܪܐ

where_it_appears: Welcome app: next button.
english_source: Next
our_translation: ܕܐܬܐ

where_it_appears: Welcome app: finish button.
english_source: Finish
our_translation: ܫܠܡ

where_it_appears: Welcome app: the show-at-startup checkbox.
english_source: Show this when I start the computer
our_translation: ܚܘܐ ܗܕܐ ܟܕ ܫܪܐ ܡܚܫܒܬܐ

where_it_appears: Welcome app: mute button for the welcome music.
english_source: Mute
our_translation: ܫܠܝ ܩܠܐ

where_it_appears: Welcome app: unmute button.
english_source: Sound on
our_translation: ܦܬܚ ܩܠܐ

where_it_appears: Welcome app: closing note on the last page.
english_source: You can open this guide again from the Bashan menu at any time.
our_translation: ܡܨܐ ܐܢܬ ܠܡܦܬܚ ܗܢܐ ܡܕܒܪܢܐ ܬܘܒ ܡܢ ܣܕܪܐ ܕܒܫܢ ܒܟܠ ܥܕܢ.

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 5 heading. Shown only to warn about disk encryption.
english_source: If you chose to encrypt this disk
our_translation: ܐܢ ܓܒܝܬ ܕܬܛܫܐ ܗܢܐ ܦܠܚܐ

where_it_appears: Installer slideshow, slide 5 body. The plain-words warning that a lost encryption password means lost data. Must stay blunt in every language.
english_source: Write the password down now and keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer. There is no reset, no recovery and no back door. If you forget it, everything on this disk is gone for good — not even we can get it back.
our_translation: ܟܬܘܒ ܡܠܬܐ ܕܥܠܠܬܐ ܗܫܐ ܘܢܛܪܝܗ ܒܐܬܪܐ ܫܪܝܪܐ, ܪܚܝܩܐ ܡܢ ܗܢܐ ܡܚܫܒܬܐ. ܠܝܬ ܬܘܪܨܐ, ܠܝܬ ܦܘܪܩܢܐ, ܠܝܬ ܬܪܥܐ ܟܣܝܐ. ܐܢ ܛܥܝܬ ܠܗ, ܟܠ ܡܐ ܕܐܝܬ ܥܠ ܗܢܐ ܦܠܚܐ ܐܒܝܕ ܠܥܠܡ — ܐܦܠܐ ܚܢܢ ܡܨܝܢܢ ܠܡܗܦܟܘܬܗ.

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 heading: privacy tools.
english_source: Private browsing tools
our_translation: ܡܐܢܐ ܕܥܒܪܐ ܟܣܝܐ

where_it_appears: Welcome app, page 7 body. States that nothing is on by default.
english_source: Bashan OS includes two tools for when you do not want your internet connection watched. Neither is switched on, and neither does anything until you set it up. There is no account to make and nothing to pay.
our_translation: ܒܫܢ ܐܝܬ ܒܗ ܬܪܝܢ ܡܐܢܐ ܠܐܡܬܝ ܕܠܐ ܨܒܐ ܐܢܬ ܕܢܬܚܙܐ ܩܘܛܪܟ ܕܐܝܢܬܪܢܬ. ܠܐ ܚܕ ܡܢܗܘܢ ܦܬܝܚܐ, ܘܠܐ ܚܕ ܥܒܕ ܡܕܡ ܥܕܡܐ ܕܡܬܩܢ ܐܢܬ ܠܗ. ܠܝܬ ܚܘܫܒܢܐ ܠܡܥܒܕ ܘܠܝܬ ܡܕܡ ܠܡܦܪܥ.

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card heading.
english_source: A VPN
our_translation: VPN

where_it_appears: Page 7: VPN card body. Must say a VPN needs a server and warn about free services.
english_source: A VPN sends your internet traffic through another computer first. Bashan OS can connect to one, but it does not come with one: a VPN needs a server, either your own or a company's. Be careful with free VPN services — many of them keep records of what you do and sell them, which is the opposite of what you wanted.
our_translation: VPN ܡܫܕܪ ܠܘܩܕܡ ܪܕܝܐ ܕܐܝܢܬܪܢܬ ܕܝܠܟ ܒܡܚܫܒܬܐ ܐܚܪܬܐ. ܒܫܢ ܡܨܐ ܕܢܬܩܛܪ ܒܚܕ, ܐܠܐ ܠܐ ܐܬܐ ܥܡ ܚܕ: VPN ܣܢܝܩ ܥܠ ܫܡܫܐ, ܐܘ ܕܝܠܟ ܐܘ ܕܫܘܬܦܘܬܐ. ܐܙܕܗܪ ܡܢ ܬܫܡܫܬܐ ܕVPN ܡܓܢܐ — ܣܓܝܐܐ ܡܢܗܘܢ ܢܛܪܝܢ ܪܫܡܐ ܕܡܐ ܕܥܒܕ ܐܢܬ ܘܡܙܒܢܝܢ ܠܗܘܢ, ܕܐܝܬܘܗܝ ܗܦܟܐ ܕܡܐ ܕܒܥܝܬ.

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card heading.
english_source: Tor Browser
our_translation: ܡܥܒܪܢܐ ܕܬܘܪ

where_it_appears: Page 7: Tor card body. Must say it downloads on first run, is slower, and some sites block it.
english_source: Tor hides which websites you visit by passing your traffic through several computers around the world. Opening it the first time downloads the browser from the Tor Project, so you need an internet connection. Two honest warnings: it is noticeably slower than normal browsing, and some websites and banks block it outright.
our_translation: ܬܘܪ ܡܛܫܐ ܐܝܠܝܢ ܕܘܟܝܬܐ ܕܣܥܪ ܐܢܬ, ܒܕܡܥܒܪ ܪܕܝܟ ܥܠ ܟܡܐ ܡܚܫܒܬܐ ܒܟܠܗ ܥܠܡܐ. ܒܙܒܢܬܐ ܩܕܡܝܬܐ ܡܬܢܚܬ ܡܥܒܪܢܐ ܡܢ ܦܘܠܚܢܐ ܕܬܘܪ, ܡܛܠ ܗܕܐ ܣܢܝܩ ܐܢܬ ܥܠ ܐܝܢܬܪܢܬ. ܬܪܝܢ ܙܘܗܪܐ ܫܪܝܪܐ: ܡܗܠܐ ܗܘ ܛܒ ܡܢ ܥܒܪܐ ܫܚܝܡܐ, ܘܡܢ ܕܘܟܝܬܐ ܘܒܝܬ ܓܙܐ ܐܝܬ ܕܟܠܝܢ ܠܗ ܓܡܝܪܐܝܬ.
